subject: AWS private offer: Net90 + early-pay credit request and temporary rev-share adjustment
messages:
From: AtlasRetail Procurement <procure@atlasretail.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Date: 2028-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private offer request — Net90 + early-pay credit; rev-share ask

Hi Karthik / Olga,

Thanks for the demo last week. AtlasRetail is ready to move forward with Redwood for our customer-facing personalization APIs, but procurement is asking for two non-standard items on the AWS private offer:

- Payment: Net90 standard, but we are requesting a 1.5% early-pay credit if payment is received within 30 days. This helps our treasury forecast.
- Marketplace rev-share: we need the marketplace commission to be reduced to 14% (from the standard 18%) for the first 12 months of the contract. Atlas can commit to a 24-month usage minimum and aggressive adoption targets for the first year.

Per AWS process, we need Redwood exec confirmation on whether you can accept both items (private offer terms + marketplace rev-share offset). Attached is our procurement request (atlas_procurement_request.pdf) with the official ask. Please advise next steps and if an exec sign-off is required.

Also CC'd AWS marketplace so they can confirm technical feasibility for the listing.

Thanks,
Erin Summers
Director, Procurement | AtlasRetail
procure@atlasretail.com

—
Attachment: atlas_procurement_request.pdf (1 page)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private offer request — Net90 + early-pay credit; rev-share ask

Marissa / Vivek,

Looping you in on a private-offer request from AtlasRetail (deal attached). Quick summary of the ask:

- AWS private offer with Net90 payment terms.
- Atlas requests a 1.5% early-pay credit if they pay within 30 days.
- They want AWS marketplace rev-share reduced to 14% for the first 12 months (we normally run 18%). In exchange they'll commit to a 24-month usage minimum and a $250k ARR adoption milestone in year one.

Financial/legal impact:
- Net90 increases bad-debt / DSO exposure; finance needs to confirm risk tolerance.
- Early-pay credit reduces upfront cash if they pay early (i.e., a discount), but it can be structured as a one-time invoice credit or an ongoing bill credit.
- Rev-share shift affects Marketplace payout waterfall and our take-rate; we'd need to agree if Redwood absorbs the difference or if Atlas will carry the difference via a higher list price.

Requested next step: can we get an exec OK to proceed with a limited approval (if acceptable, I can ask Legal to produce a redline and submit the private offer to AWS)? If you want finance/legal to model the delta first, we can loop them.

I've attached a short term summary that proposes options (redwood_term_summary_v1.docx). If we need to escalate to platform leadership for policy exception, please state approval thresholds.

Thanks — Karthik
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: redwood_term_summary_v1.docx (proposed options: absorb rev-share delta vs. raise list price; early-pay credit as invoice-level credit)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-01T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer request — Net90 + early-pay credit; rev-share ask

Karthik — thanks for the concise summary. I reviewed the proposed options and ran a quick back-of-envelope with finance. Decision and guardrails below: 

1) Approve proceeding to Legal + Marketplace submission to confirm feasibility. This is an approval to *negotiation* and to draft a private-offer that reflects the ask.

2) Commercial guardrails (must hold):
   - Maximum rev-share concession = 3.5 percentage points off standard (i.e., 18% -> 14.5%). We shouldn't go below 14% without CFO sign-off.
   - Duration cap: concession allowed for 12 months only; after that revert to standard rate or staged increase.
   - Early-pay credit allowed up to 1.5% if structured as an invoice-level credit triggered by payment within 30 days. Finance will verify accounting treatment but is okay with modeling the credit as a vendor rebate.
   - Net90 accepted for enterprise customers but require a signed SOW and pre-authorized credit review by Revenue Ops. No rollover credit beyond the committed 24 months.

3) Conditions before final exec sign-off:
   - Legal to confirm the private-offer language and ensure we don’t take on marketplace indemnities.
   - Finance to confirm cashflow modeling and allocate the concession to the deal bench.
   - Create a Canary clause: if usage is below the agreed milestone at month 12, Redwood can reclaim the rev-share concession retroactively (i.e., true-up).

If Legal/Finance clear these, I give conditional exec-level approval to list the private offer under these guardrails. Please put the final motion in HubSpot and tag me for a short sign-off.

Marissa
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

—

Date: 2028-07-02T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Private offer request — Net90 + early-pay credit; rev-share ask

Hi Karthik / Olga,

Thanks — we can support listing a private offer that contains Net90 payment terms and a line item reflecting an early-pay rebate. A couple of implementation notes:

- AWS cannot directly change the marketplace commission rate on our side. The marketplace rev-share is a contract between Redwood and AWS; however we can list a pricing structure where Redwood sets the list price and applies an upfront promotional credit to yield the effective economics you want.

- For your requested concession window (12 months), we recommend embedding a schedule in your private-offer that auto-expiries the promotional credit at month 12.

- We generated the provisional private-offer JSON for the listing: aws-private-offer-12345.json (attached). Please review and confirm pricing and effective dates.

Next steps for Redwood:
1) Finalize Legal/Finance sign-offs and send the definitive private-offer payload back to us.
2) Provide the HubSpot deal link and the signed SOW or MSA that authorizes Net90.
3) Confirm whether Redwood will absorb the delta to marketplace rev-share or whether you want us to list a promotional credit that nets out the economics for Atlas.

Once we have the final payload we can create the private listing and share the acceptance confirmation.

Cheers,
Robert Lee
AWS Marketplace Ops
marketplace-ops@amazon.com

—
